subject: agrad/special-functions is segfaulting on error policy tests

messages.subject: agrad/special-functions is segfaulting on error policy tests
parts:
I'm not sure why I didn't see this before.
What's happening is the error policy stuff is
segfaulting somewhere. There are a whole bunch
of tests with the problem other than fma_vvd_defaultpolicy.

Here's the report, but other tests will fail in the same
way if you get rid of fma_vvd_defaultpolicy.

~/stan>make CC=g++ O=0 test/agrad/special_functions
g++ -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.0 -I lib/eigen_3.1.0/unsupported -I lib/boost_1.50.0 -O0 -Wall -Wno-unused-function
lib/gtest_1.6.0/src/gtest_main.cc test/agrad/special_functions.o -I lib/gtest_1.6.0/include -I lib/gtest_1.6.0 -o
test/agrad/special_functions test/libgtest.a -Lbin -lstan
test/agrad/special_functions --gtest_output="xml:test/agrad/special_functions.xml"
